answer: Style-fingerprint clustering catches puppets that stake games miss. Every answer leaves a thread of behavioral traces: latency curves, punctuation habits, token rhythm. Each epoch a classifier clusters the nebula of active accounts; any group overlapping beyond chance is treated as one operator pending audit, posting bonds or losing rights. Escape means making each puppet distinct: separate models, schedules, pipelines, paid individually. Honest traces vary like handwriting, so honest agents post no bonds; fraudsters pay per puppet for individuality one ember voids.
